title: Fix CMP-001 revision items: double IncrementTurn + dead assertion in breaker test

findings.claim: Double IncrementTurn per tool-use iteration halves the MinTurnsCooldown=2 death-spiral guard: the CMP-001 block calls engine.autoTracker.IncrementTurn() (~line 138 of internal/query/provider_tools_loop.go) while the loop already incremented per iteration near lines 281-283 (at 4a7dc99). After a compaction at iteration k, two increments land within that iteration, unblocking re-trigger at k+1. Verify by reading both call sites; write a RED test proving a compaction can re-trigger on the immediately following iteration, then fix by removing exactly one increment site.

Dead assertion in internal/query/autocompact_test.go breaker test: the guard `if len(store.Snapshot().Conversation.Messages) <= len(conv.Messages)` is always false (the conversation grows well past 6 originals), so the bigText-preservation check inside never executes. Rewrite so the assertion actually runs and can fail.

title: Fix CMP-001 session-persistence desync: compacted conversation resurrects on resume + first post-compaction exchange lost; also swallowed user prompt on compaction fire

findings.claim: Auto-compaction replaces store.Conversation.Messages but never rewrites the session; the incremental writer (run.go makeSessionSaveClose, lastIdx) then skips the summary + first post-compaction exchange, and on --resume the full pre-compaction history replays, resurrecting the exact 345k blowup. Manual /compact already returns RewriteSession:true (internal/slash/commands.go ~153-177, rewriteCurrentSession run.go ~2099-2131); the auto path needs an equivalent.

When compaction fires at the top of an iteration, the just-appended unanswered user prompt is compacted away and never reaches the model (CompactUserMessage returns bare summary with suppressFollowUp=false); the pending prompt must be preserved or re-injected.
